coverage_override.reason: The summon procedure and its limit, two following triggered effects, and their shared each-effect HOPT sentence are four audit units.

effects.printed_clause: If you control an Aquamarine monster, you can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can only Special Summon Aquamarine Moon Aurelia once per turn this way.
effects.lua_implementation: An uncopyable hand EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC requires an open zone and a controlled Aquamarine monster. An oath count keyed to this card now enforces the once-per-turn procedure.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses an uncopyable hand EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC with an oath SetCountLimit.

effects.issue: Fixed: the printed once-per-turn Special Summon procedure now has an oath count limit.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 Aquamarine Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed EVENT_SPSUMMON_SUCCESS trigger searches an eligible archetype Spell/Trap, adds it, reveals it, and uses the card id as a hard once-per-turn key.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses a delayed summon-success trigger, filtered hand addition, and id-keyed limit.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is banished from your GY: You can Fusion Summon 1 Aquamarine Fusion Monster by banishing its listed materials from your field and/or GY.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed EVENT_REMOVE trigger checks previous GY location, builds legal field/GY materials under Necrovalley, supports Chain Material, banishes selected materials with Fusion reasons, Fusion Summons, and completes the procedure.

official_references.matched_structure: Fusion Summons using banished GY-accessible materials and completes the procedure.

official_references.card_name: Grapha, Dragon Overlord of Dark World
official_references.matched_structure: Checks mixed Fusion material requirements and performs the Fusion Summon operation.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each of the following effects of Aquamarine Moon Aurelia once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The search and banishment-triggered Fusion effects use distinct id and id+100 hard keys; the separately worded summon procedure uses its own oath key.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses distinct id-keyed limits for separate effects.
